{{Quote|He's been transmitting to the Empire. There's an ambush waiting for us at the Markez Moon pipeline. Neen Valley.|Saw Gerrera addressing his partisans after killing Pluti.|<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />}}
The '''Markez Moon pipeline''' was a pipeline on [[Markez Moon]] that transported [[Rhydonium]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. The junction for [[Station Four]] of the pipeline ran through [[Neen Valley]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> 

In [[3 BBY]]<ref name="GhormanDate">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" dates the events of "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" to [[3 BBY]].</ref> [[Saw Gerrera]] feed false intel to a mole working for the [[Galactic Empire]] within his [[Partisans|rebel cell]] by telling the mole, [[Pluti]], that the group was going to execute a [[Rhydonium heist]] on at the Station Four junction of the pipeline.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Markez Moon pipeline was first mentioned in "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," the fifth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
